messages:
Alex M.: Hey payroll — my Feb 26 paycheck had CA state tax withheld even though I moved to AZ on 2026-02-10 and updated my address in Workday on 2026-02-11. Can someone check? I attached the paystub but posting key lines: gross $8,400; CA state withheld $520.
Michelle - Payroll: Thanks Alex. Can you confirm your employee ID and whether you submitted a state withholding form (AZ Form A-4 equivalent) in the HR portal? Also need last 4 SSN to pull the payrun.
Alex M.: Employee ID 6789, last4 4321. I ticked the address update in Workday and uploaded a PDF of my AZ residency (utility bill) on 2026-02-11. I didn't see a separate state form UI though.
Payroll Bot: Payroll run PR-2026-02-28 processed 2026-02-28 03:14 UTC. Employee 6789 processed under payroll profile: CA_STANDARD.
Sara (People Ops): :eyes: FYI the move workflow has two steps: address change + state tax change. Address alone doesn't flip withholding in some legacy profiles. We should tidy that UX but for now Payroll needs to run a retro adjustment.
Michelle - Payroll: Got it. I can queue a correction. Quick check: did you work any days in CA during Feb (onboarding/training) or were you fully remote from AZ after 2026-02-10? That affects resident/part-year rules.
Alex M.: I was remote from AZ starting 2026-02-11 (no CA office visit). So withholding should be AZ-only from 2026-02-11 onwards.
Michelle - Payroll: OK. We'll run an off-cycle reversal for the CA withholding and apply AZ withholding retro to 2026-02-11. Command I'm going to run:
```
payroll_cli adjust-withholding --empid 6789 --from-state CA --to-state AZ --effective-date 2026-02-11 --retro true --payrun PR-2026-02-28
```
Michelle - Payroll: Estimated outcome: refund CA withheld $520 via correcting check and withhold AZ appropriate (~$210) so net off-cycle pay ~+$310 pre-tax differences. We'll also log for year-end W-2 adjustments.
Alex M.: Appreciate it. Will this generate a W-2c or just an internal adjustment? Do I need to do anything for state filing?
Michelle - Payroll: We'll issue a corrected payroll record and coordinate W-2/W-2c if required. For CA we may file a state-level refund/adjustment. I'll follow up with next steps and expected off-cycle date (aiming EOD 2026-03-03).
Sara (People Ops): Adding note: confirm nexus check done by finance for AZ residency (should be fine but want to avoid tax nexus surprises). Michelle, pls tag finance if needed.
Michelle - Payroll: Will do. Tagging finance via email. Alex, I'll DM you when correction posts and include updated paystub. :thumbsup:
Alex M.: Thanks team!
Michelle - Payroll: Update 2026-03-03 14:05 UTC: off-cycle processed, correction ID CORR-4592. CA withholding refunded by negative withholding in off-cycle and AZ withholding applied retro. Please review the corrected stub I just attached to your Workday inbox.
Alex M.: Reviewed — stub looks correct, refund processed. Thanks for the quick turnaround.
Payroll Bot: Note: CORR-4592 queued for W-2 reconciliation at year-end; possible W-2c issuance if totals differ after final close.
Sara (People Ops): Closing loop — Alex, if you get any CA refund notices from state, forward to payroll@redwood.com. We'll keep records attached to your HR file.
Alex M.: Will do. Thanks everyone!
